title: Quote the Exchange
description: Before moving value, the wallet wants a price from the anchor: how much off-chain currency buys a given amount of on-ledger USDC today. The anchor exposes a standardized RFQ endpoint for that.

options: A quote API for exchanging off-chain assets and Stellar assets
Hosted deposit and withdrawal through an anchor webview

solution: A quote API for exchanging off-chain assets and Stellar assets
hint: SEP-38 defines indicative and firm quotes between an off-chain asset and an on-chain Stellar asset, including the price and the amounts for each side. Hosted transfers are SEP-24, authentication is SEP-10, and cross-border payments are SEP-31. Documentation: https://developers.stellar.org/docs/build/apps/wallet/sep38
author: StellarHunts Core
